t: You're looking at the Quadrant, the curving stretch of buildings where Regent Street meets Air Street and Glasshouse Street, in Westminster. The listing covers a long run of addresses, including the Quadrant Arcade. It was designed by Reginald Blomfield, a prolific British architect, garden designer and author of the Victorian and Edwardian period. Blomfield is the name to hold on to here, so as you walk the curve, notice how the frontages work together as one design.
